name: Changzuiornis
sum: Ornithuromorph from the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning with a very long beak.
holotype: AGB5840, a skeleton from Sihedang near Lingyuan.
biology: Its long beak gave the genus its name.
author: Huang et al. 2018
